svg.text: STACKCALC • THANK YOU FOR SUPPORTING HANDS-ON MATH
DESIGNED & 3D-MANUFACTURED IN SMALL BATCHES • CALIFORNIA, USA

g.text: OUR STORY, EXTRA BLOCKS & FREE REPLACEMENT PROMISE
Math shouldn't feel like memorizing arbitrary rules on a worksheet. When learners can physically stack, compare, and feel how
numbers, fractions, and prime factors fit together, abstract concepts click for life.
We often include a few extra blocks in your package as spares or as samples from other kits in our collection. If a piece ever goes
missing after a busy session, visit stackcalc.io anytime for free printable guides or replacement blocks.
Every block, tray, and enclosure is 3D-printed and inspected in our workshop. As a small independent studio, your feedback and
reviews mean the world to us—thank you for bringing hands-on math to your table or classroom!
✓ SCAN THE QR CODE FOR INTERACTIVE 3D GUIDES, PRINTABLE ACTIVITIES & REPLACEMENT PARTS
